caveats: Forward rows are observed market/snapshot evidence, not historical research records and not executable quotes or fills.
Historical Polymarket rows are PRICE_PROXY when persisted quality says PRICE_PROXY; no depth, spread, settlement, or fill is fabricated.
Aggregate counts and hashes are exact for rows reachable in the single read transaction; illustrative per-market rows and export are bounded.

Lifecycle status is a latest-metadata as-of projection only; contemporaneous metadata coverage is reported separately using metadata.observed_at <= snapshot.observed_at and is not inferred from future/latest rows.
Missing metadata/snapshot and sequence gaps are storage-coverage gaps, not claims about provider availability outside the persisted source.
Source file/WAL stat changes during the read are reported; the transaction still provides one SQLite snapshot to this connection.

FORWARD_COLLECTED.metadata_alignment: each record is the latest persisted metadata at or before first/last selected snapshot observed_at; absent prior metadata is omitted

HISTORICAL.metadata_alignment: each record is the latest persisted metadata at or before first/last selected snapshot observed_at; absent prior metadata is omitted

forward_market_snapshot.trades: No trade rows are present in the reachable source partition

FORWARD_COLLECTED.as_of_definition: latest metadata observed_at in this source partition

contemporaneous_snapshot_metadata.alignment_rule: metadata source_type and market_id match, metadata.observed_at <= snapshot.observed_at

status_projection.classification: exact aggregate; per-market IDs are not fully embedded

HISTORICAL.as_of_definition: latest metadata observed_at in this source partition

contemporaneous_snapshot_metadata.alignment_rule: metadata source_type and market_id match, metadata.observed_at <= snapshot.observed_at

status_projection.classification: exact aggregate; per-market IDs are not fully embedded

provenance.classification: exact for persisted source_type columns; latest metadata payload projection

timestamp_roles.created_at: persistence creation time; not substituted for source chronology
timestamp_roles.provider_timestamp: retained only if present inside raw payload; not synthesized

immutability.append_only_claim: Rows are treated as immutable only under the persisted primary/identity keys; this utility never writes or repairs rows.

same_market_sequences.definition: Snapshots ordered by source_timestamp,snapshot_id within market; observed_at monotonicity checked in that order

schema.excluded_table_policy: Schema names may be discovered; excluded payloads are never selected.

scope.aggregate_classification: exact over reachable rows in one SQLite read snapshot
scope.export_classification: bounded deterministic typed HISTORICAL research + FORWARD_COLLECTED replay-evidence sample
scope.forward_dataset: FORWARD_COLLECTED market/snapshot coverage; never relabeled as historical
scope.purpose: release baseline research-data evidence and forward-coverage inventory
scope.research_dataset: HISTORICAL Polymarket price/depth records as persisted; no synthetic fills
scope.sequence_detail_classification: exact aggregate; bounded illustrative per-market sample

source.transaction: BEGIN DEFERRED before application SELECTs; rollback after export/report facts
